description: Ricochet RC-01 Concept A with the selected off-the-shelf actuators on every surface (limits read from docs/ricochet/components/components.json) and hinged planing skis with fins under the outboard sponson pods. Legacy Concept A is unchanged when no profile is selected.

servo_loop.stiffness_rule: kp = rated torque / 1 deg (assumed: Volz publishes position accuracy, not loop stiffness)

reverse_bucket.hinge_offset_note: Iteration 1 of the hinge-axis placement: 0.11 m (as lofted) gave ~250 N m; moving the axis to 0.04 m from the jet load line gives ~90 N m at 1,450 N per fan.
reverse_bucket.lock_note: Mechanical over-centre lock carries the jet load at full deployment; actuator only moves the bucket.

skis.mass_status: assumed: carbon sandwich planing ski with fin and fittings

actuator.stroke_note: Iteration 1: the register's 76 mm stroke on a 0.44 m lever gives only 9.9 deg of travel; collective 0-10 deg plus +/-4 deg differential within the -3..12 deg joint needs 15 deg (115 mm). 152.4 mm (6 in) is within the published 76-457 mm range and gives 20 deg.

skis.hydro_model: Savitsky planing (flat bottom, zero deadrise) with geometric wetted length; low-aspect-ratio submerged plate when the leading edge is under water, blended over half a beam of leading-edge depth; Helmbold fin lift with ventilation cap; ITTC-57 friction.
